explanation.summary: The website https://www.ucsg365.vercel.app/ is identified as confirmed malicious due to multiple indicators of phishing activity, including being listed in a phishing database, AI-based phishing detection, false claims of being a Microsoft site, and requests for sensitive credentials. It should not be accessed by any user.
key_points: The site is listed in a known phishing database, confirming it is a known malicious destination. [F1]
An AI model has determined with 100% confidence that this domain is related to phishing activity. [F2]
The page falsely claims to be a Microsoft login page, which is a common tactic used in phishing attacks. [F3]
The site is hosted on a public platform where malicious content is frequently shared, increasing the risk of phishing. [F4]
The page includes password fields and asks for sensitive information, which is a major red flag for phishing. [F5]
The site lacks essential security headers that protect against common attacks like content injection or clickjacking. [F6, F7, F8]
The site uses JavaScript to redirect users to another page (tarjeta.html), which could be part of a deceptive or malicious flow. [F9]
Do not visit or enter any personal information on this website. It is likely a phishing site designed to steal your credentials.
Report this site to your organization's security team or to the relevant authorities immediately.

recommendations: Do not open this link or reply. Report it and delete it.
Do not open this link or enter any information.
Navigate to the organisation's official site directly.
Only enter credentials on the organisation's official domain.
limitations: Automated checks can miss new or targeted attacks; a low-risk result is not a guarantee of safety.
A valid HTTPS certificate only proves an encrypted connection, not that the website is legitimate.
Only passive, non-intrusive checks were performed; no exploitation or active scanning.
